title: TextField
description: A single-line text input with a floating label, icons, validation message and many styling options.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: name and label are required. The label floats above the value; a placeholder replaces it visually, and the label stays the accessible name.

controlled.title: Controlled
controlled.description: Pass value and onChange to control the field. onChange receives the new string value.

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: Show an icon on the left (default) or on the right.

password.title: Password
password.description: With type="password" and a right icon, the icon becomes a show/hide toggle.

clearable-and-count.title: Clearable and character count
clearable-and-count.description: clearable shows a clear button when the field has a value (focus returns to the field after clearing); showCharCount displays the length. defaultValue sets the initial value of an uncontrolled field.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Minimal (bottom border only), borderless, or a custom border radius and color.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: Three sizes: small, medium (default) and large.

width-and-suffix.title: Width and suffix
width-and-suffix.description: Set a width or use fullWidth; suffix displays content such as a unit at the end.

states.title: States
states.description: Disabled and read-only fields. The hidden floating label of a read-only field still names it for screen readers.

validation.title: Validation
validation.description: helperText shows an error message and switches the field to the error state. Submit an invalid email to see it.

TextFieldProps.name: Name of the input; also used as its id (unless id is set) to link the label
TextFieldProps.id: Id of the input; defaults to name
TextFieldProps.label: Floating label. Hidden when a placeholder is set or the field is read-only; it then remains the input's accessible name
TextFieldProps.value: Current value (controlled); omit for an uncontrolled field
TextFieldProps.defaultValue: Initial value of an uncontrolled field
TextFieldProps.placeholder: Placeholder text, replaces the floating label
TextFieldProps.helperText: Error message shown below the field (linked with aria-describedby); switches it to the error state, focuses the input and shakes it briefly
TextFieldProps.iconPosition: Side of the icon; with type="password" a right icon becomes a show/hide toggle
TextFieldProps.minimal: Minimal style with only a bottom border
TextFieldProps.clearable: Shows a clear button when the field has a value
TextFieldProps.fullWidth: Takes the full width of the container (overrides width)
TextFieldProps.width: Width of the field (any CSS length)
TextFieldProps.ariaLabel: Accessible label of the input (defaults to label)
TextFieldProps.clearLabel: Accessible label of the clear button
TextFieldProps.showPasswordLabel: Accessible label of the password toggle while the password is hidden
TextFieldProps.hidePasswordLabel: Accessible label of the password toggle while the password is visible
TextFieldProps.suffix: Content shown at the end of the field, e.g. a unit
TextFieldProps.onChange: Called with the new value on every change; pass value as well to control the field
TextFieldProps.onBlur: Called when the input loses focus
TextFieldProps.onFocus: Called when the input gains focus
TextFieldProps.onKeyDown: Called on key down in the input
TextFieldProps.className: Additional class name of the container
